item.content:encoded:
The two-week BKSEC training session has concluded, garnering significant interest from students at Hanoi University of Science and Technology. This event aims to provide students with a greater understanding of the IT security business and the CTF competition format and to acquire valuable professional expertise.

[BKSEC is a student club within the School of Information and Communication Technology. The club has arranged multiple activities to cultivate students’ enthusiasm for information security.]

item.title: Field trip to the Muong Sang 3 hydropower plant
item.dc:creator: bkcs
item.description: Over a three-day time span, from February 15 to 17, the BKCS Center conducted a survey expedition at the Muong
item.content:encoded: Over a three-day time span, from February 15 to 17, the BKCS Center conducted a survey expedition at the Muong Sang 3 Hydropower Plant. The field survey constitutes one of the activities under the project KC.01.04/21-30, entitled “A comprehensive solution for the security of industrial control systems”. This project is conducted by the Center from December 2024 to September 2027, aiming to develop a comprehensive solution that includes both hardware and software to monitor, identify, and mitigate attacks on the Industrial Control System/Operational Technology (ICS/OT) in factories and industrial organizations.
